reel:
10 days of only Maggi can wipe out a big part of your gut bacteria. What instant noodles every day do inside you.
Your gut bacteria live on fibre from dal, sabzi and fruit. In a 2015 experiment, a scientist's son ate only fast food for 10 days and lost about 40% of his gut bacteria types.
Full story on YouTube: what 30 days of only Maggi does to your body, day by day.
What's your go-to Maggi add-on? Tell me in the comments.
#whatif #maggi #guthealth
short:
7 Maggi packets a day for a month: your face changes first. Here's what only eating Maggi does to your body.
One 70 g packet has about 36% of your daily salt limit, so 7 packets is about 3 times the limit. By day 3 you look puffy, by week 1 there's almost no fibre, by day 10 your gut bacteria are starving.
Full story on YouTube, with what happens on day 30.
Longest you've ever survived on just Maggi? Tell me in the comments.
#whatif #maggi #health
